prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. One strong central scene occupies about two thirds. All supplied teaching text MUST be rendered INSIDE the image. Preserve Swedish å, ä, ö and every letter exactly. Header text verbatim: "en utbildning". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "education".
Scene: A young adult arriving at college on an autumn morning, carrying books past golden leaves.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "utbilda → utbildning: educate → education.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Han börjar sin utbildning i höst.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Use attached image ONLY for style and layout, accurate text and Swedish diacritics. One square image. CRITICAL: the example says HAN (he), so depict an unmistakably ADULT MAN arriving at university in autumn, NO WOMAN as the learner.
